name: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Field Trauma Injector FTI-5
product_name: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Field Trauma Injector FTI-5
description: An auto-injector containing a cocktail of combat trauma pharmaceuticals — pain suppression, blood coagulant, adrenaline stabilizer, and broad-spectrum antibiotic — designed for self-administration in the field. The FTI-5 is a single-use device pressed against any large muscle group and activated with a button press, delivering its payload through a micro-needle array that ensures rapid absorption. Within 15 seconds, pain is suppressed to functional levels, hemorrhaging is reduced, and the recipient enters a stable, alert state that allows continued operation despite injuries that would normally be debilitating. The effect lasts approximately 45 minutes, after which the recipient will require medical attention for whatever injuries they have been ignoring.

specifications.contents: Pain suppressor + coagulant + adrenaline stabilizer + antibiotic
specifications.post-effect: Medical attention required for suppressed injuries

story_hooks: A fighter injected three FTI-5 doses in sequence to stay operational for over two hours despite critical injuries — when the drugs wore off, the accumulated trauma killed them instantly.
Counterfeit FTI-5 units have appeared that replace the pain suppressor with a powerful sedative — operators who inject them in combat situations fall unconscious within 30 seconds.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, pen-sized auto-injector with a tapered cylindrical body that fits naturally in a closed fist. The design prioritizes ergonomics and rapid deployment—no fumbling, no confusion in high-stress situations. The top third features a textured grip zone in contrasting material; the lower two-thirds taper to a flat delivery end with a translucent window revealing the micro-needle array beneath. The overall impression is clinical precision married with street-ready functionality.
physical_description.dimensions: 15 cm length, 1.8 cm diameter—comparable to a thick permanent marker or fountain pen
physical_description.weight_description: Negligible (50g)—easily pocket-carried, belt-clipped, or secured in a med-pouch without noticeable burden
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade polymer body with reinforced titanium alloy tip housing; injection window is sapphire composite
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal polymer with anodized silver accents; the delivery window has a faint frosted appearance to obscure the internal mechanism while remaining translucent enough to verify liquid payload
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary with emergency-orange grip stripe and Lazarus Pharmaceuticals' signature teal accent ring at the midpoint. Glowing teal status indicator beneath the grip zone
physical_description.interface_elements: Single large convex activation button (silver) on the upper grip zone, recessed slightly to prevent accidental discharge. Teal LED indicator (off when armed, solid when depleted). Micro-text labeling along the barrel in multiple languages. Small dial at the base showing contents level and expiry date readout
distinctive_features: Micro-needle array visible through sapphire window—hundreds of hair-thin needles arranged in a circular pattern
Teal status LED that glows softly when armed
Emergency-orange grip stripe that extends partway down the barrel
Haptic feedback button with tactile click confirmation
Pressure-sensitive tip that prevents activation unless pressed firmly against tissue
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS embossed on upper barrel in metallic silver; FTI-5 model designation and batch number laser-etched below; small Φ symbol with price tier indicator (1+); regulatory compliance marks for GLMZ medical authority
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new—no visible wear. In field use, slight scuffing on grip zone from extraction and impact; the translucent window may show residual medication staining if recently discharged. Often carried in dedicated med-pouch or quick-draw holster on tactical harnesses
